threadId: 64c8b1e2-f85c-440a-9922-dfe8ce70728a ### 一、方案判断：是否修中真实缺口？ **判断：准确切中真实缺口，且边界控制得当。** 对照当前仓库实现，读者在 README 看到“横条贯穿五阶段、表格只在首尾两行提 `research-wiki`”并非单纯的文案疏漏，底层技能确实存在三处不对称： 1. **[mathrsi-prove/SKILL.md](file:///Users/rfy_naiveai/Desktop/MathRSI/base/skills/mathrsi-prove/SKILL.md#L16-L18) 入口漏了显式 Wiki 实体检索**：第 16 行只要求读 `FORMAL_SPEC.md`、`ROUTE_REPORT.md` 和路线链接，未要求在入口（尤其跳过 `route-loop` 直接进 `prove` 时）先查 `/research-wiki/` 的既有失败配置与进口条件；且直到第 6 节交接前（[第 211 行](file:///Users/rfy_naiveai/Desktop/MathRSI/base/skills/mathrsi-prove/SKILL.md#L211)）才提写回，中途证出关键条件引理或严格反例时缺少即时沉淀。 2. **[mathrsi-verify/SKILL.md](file:///Users/rfy_naiveai/Desktop/MathRSI/base/skills/mathrsi-verify/SKILL.md#L155) 在“直接 Lean 分支（§4）”与“纯确定性核验分支（§1）”缺少普通 Wiki 写回**：第 155 行依赖 `proof-checker` 自身的 Hook 4 更新 Wiki（仅第 73 行补查文献时顺带提了一句 `research-wiki`）。当任务走**直接 Lean 出口**或**局部确定性证书/反例核验**而不跑 `proof-checker` 时，Hook 4 不会触发，导致已核验的导出声明、显式参数边界或确定性反例未能写回 `research-wiki/`。 3. **[mathrsi-route-loop/SKILL.md](file:///Users/rfy_naiveai/Desktop/MathRSI/base/skills/mathrsi-route-loop/SKILL.md#L18) 虽首尾有 Wiki，但中途轮次（Phase C/E）缺少重大反例/失败域的及时落盘说明**，且 [mathrsi-research/SKILL.md](file:///Users/rfy_naiveai/Desktop/MathRSI/base/skills/mathrsi-research/SKILL.md#L54-L62) 主表未写明父调用者如何在阶段切换时消费 Wiki 新增内容。 您在 [WORKSPACE.md](file:///Users/rfy_naiveai/Desktop/MathRSI/docs/WORKSPACE.md) 集中定义共用读写规程与五阶段表，并在 `research`、`route-loop`、`prove`、`verify` 对齐入口读取、重大节点写回与父 caller 消费，完全不需要新增技能或外层平台即可闭环。 --- ### 二、落地时需注意的 4 点具体修正（防踩 `research_wiki.py` 参数陷阱） 在将上述设计写入 [WORKSPACE.md](file:///Users/rfy_naiveai/Desktop/MathRSI/docs/WORKSPACE.md) 与各 `SKILL.md` 时，建议把以下 4 条与 [research-wiki/SKILL.md](file:///Users/rfy_naiveai/Desktop/MathRSI/base/skills/skills-codex/research-wiki/SKILL.md) 底层脚本强相关的细节写准： 1. **既有 `ideas/` 与 `papers/` 页严禁传 `--update-on-exist`（防模板覆盖正文）**： * `research_wiki.py upsert_idea`（及 `ingest_paper`）默认 `skip-on-exist`；一旦加 `--update-on-exist`，脚本会用初始空模板重写整页，清空此前积累的引理推导、反例范围和 `VERIFICATION.md` 链接。 * **准确写法**：仅在新建路线/方法节点时调一次 `upsert_idea`（不带 `--update-on-exist`）；对已有 `ideas/.md` 或 `papers/.md` 增补条件引理、反例域、直接 Lean 或局部核验结论时，**直接由唯一协调者增量编辑该 Markdown 正文对应章节及顶栏 `stage`/`outcome`（切勿手改自动生成的 `## Connections` 节）**，随后执行 `add_edge`、`rebuild_index`、`rebuild_query_pack` 和 `log`，再读回核对。 2. **`add_experiment` 的 `--verdict` 映射与“先建节点后连边”顺序**： * `research_wiki.py add_experiment` 的 `--verdict` 仅接受 `yes | partial | no` 且**默认值为 `no`**；同时 `add_edge` **不校验节点是否存在**。 * **准确写法**： * 仅在计算探针、证书重放或确定性核验**已有明确结论**时调用 `add_experiment`（见证/必要门在声明域通过传 `yes`；仅工作集通过、有条件引理或缺秩池保留合法对象传 `partial`；严格反例、全域排除或证明松弛恒等无收益传 `no`）。**在途运行、超时或 `UNKNOWN` 状态只记入 `NEXT_SESSION.md` 与阶段报告，绝不调用 `add_experiment` 触发默认 `no`**。 * 调用 `add_edge --from ... --to ...` 前，确认两端 `paper:`、`idea:`、`exp:` 节点文件已存在。 3. **`verify` 直接 Lean 分支（§4）与确定性核验（§1）的写回落点**： * 明确规定：`claims/.md`（`claim:`）专属于 `proof-checker` 真实审计（Hook 4），其他任何分支**不调用 `add_claim`、也不为写 Wiki 强跑 `proof-checker`**。 * 当 `verify` 走直接 Lean 分支、领域证书重放或局部提前验证时，协调者将**实际构建模块、导出声明、全部显式参数 `(h : ...)` 与外部前提边界、确定性检查范围及 `VERIFICATION.md` 路径**增量写入对应 `ideas/.md`（必要时配一个 `exp:` 节点及 `supports`/`invalidates` 边），并刷新 `index.md`、`query_pack.md` 与 `log.md`。 4. **明确区分 `/research-wiki/`（可写）与插件 `archive` 内历史 Wiki（只读）**： * 在 [mathrsi-research/SKILL.md](file:///Users/rfy_naiveai/Desktop/MathRSI/base/skills/mathrsi-research/SKILL.md) 与 [WORKSPACE.md](file:///Users/rfy_naiveai/Desktop/MathRSI/docs/WORKSPACE.md) 中点明：所有 `research_wiki.py` 写入命令只针对当前任务工作区 `/research-wiki/`（且每次 shell 调用显式 `export ARIS_REPO="/abs/path/to/MathRSI/base"` 并过滤环境报错噪声）；`plugins/degree-diameter/archive/` 或 `plugins/propertyb/knowledge/` 中的源 Wiki 仅作只读方法参考，绝不对其运行 `init`、`rebuild_*` 或写入操作。 --- ### 三、可直接用于 README 的双语说明与五阶段读写表 #### 1. 英文版（用于替换 [README.md](file:///Users/rfy_naiveai/Desktop/MathRSI/README.md#L90-L101) 图下说明与五阶段表） ```markdown The diagram is retained as the **v2 historical workflow view**; the same five stages remain in v3. The horizontal **Continuous Research Wiki** bar means `/research-wiki/` is read and updated across **all five stages**, not only during initial survey or final handoff: the stage coordinator locates entries via `index.md` / `query_pack.md`, reads full entity pages (`papers/`, `ideas/`, `experiments/`, `claims/`) for active obligations, and records reusable lemmas, strict counterexamples, and verification scopes as soon as they are established (via `$ARIS_REPO/tools/research_wiki.py`, keeping canonical `claim:` nodes strictly reserved for real `proof-checker` audits). See **[docs/WORKSPACE.md](docs/WORKSPACE.md)** for the shared read/write protocol. | Subworkflow | What It Does | Embedded ARIS Skills Used | Wiki Read / Write (`/research-wiki/`) | Primary Outputs | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **1. [`mathrsi-prepare`](base/skills/mathrsi-prepare/SKILL.md)** | Chains [`mathrsi-specify`](base/skills/mathrsi-specify/SKILL.md) (preliminary) $\rightarrow$ [`mathrsi-survey`](base/skills/mathrsi-survey/SKILL.md) (alias/citation/errata search & primary-source verification) $\rightarrow$ `mathrsi-specify` (final). | `research-lit`, `research-wiki`, `wiki-enrich` | **Read**: existing `index.md`, `query_pack.md`, `gap_map.md`, and relevant `papers/`/`ideas/` pages.
**Write**: `init` (if new), `ingest_paper`, `wiki-enrich` (exact theorem conditions/errata), `add_edge`, rebuild `index`/`query_pack` & `log`. | `FORMAL_SPEC.md`, `LITERATURE.md`, updated wiki entities | | **2. [`mathrsi-route-loop`](base/skills/mathrsi-route-loop/SKILL.md)** | Mathematical adaptation of `auto-review-loop`: proposes a proof route, runs adversarial review, executes math/compute probes, revises the route, and rechecks with persistent reviewer memory. | `auto-review-loop` *(math adaptation)*, `research-review` *(composed)*, `research-wiki` | **Read**: `query_pack.md` + full `ideas/`, `experiments/`, and `papers/` pages for failed routes and imports.
**Write**: `upsert_idea` (new routes) or body edits (existing routes), `add_experiment` (`yes`/`partial`/`no` for completed probes), `add_edge`, rebuild & `log` on decisive refutations and at final round. | `ROUTE_REPORT.md` with first concrete proof obligations & reviewer traces | | **3. [`mathrsi-prove`](base/skills/mathrsi-prove/SKILL.md)** | Stabilizes objects and derivations, drafts lemmas, runs domain computations or parallel workers with exclusive write scopes, and binds results back to the original problem caller. | `formula-derivation`, `proof-writer`, `proof-orchestrator` *(optional)*, `research-wiki` | **Read**: entry check of `index.md`/`query_pack.md` $\rightarrow$ full entity pages for active `ideas/`, imported `papers/`, and prior `experiments/`/`claims/`.
**Write**: single-writer incremental body updates to `ideas/` and `add_experiment`/`add_edge` when conditional lemmas, domain certificates, or strict counterexamples land, plus pre-handoff sync. | `PROOF_DRAFT.md`, computational certificates, or exact blocking gaps | | **4. [`mathrsi-verify`](base/skills/mathrsi-verify/SKILL.md)** | Assembles natural-language proofs for deterministic checks and the `proof-checker` repair loop; routes formal-only goals directly to `lean-formalize` to check actual exports, explicit parameters, build, and axioms. | `proof-writer` *(via assemble)*, `proof-checker`, `lean-formalize` *(optional)*, `research-wiki` | **Read**: full `ideas/`, `papers/`, and `claims/` pages for import conditions and scope boundaries.
**Write**: `proof-checker` mints/updates canonical `claims/` via Hook 4; direct-Lean and deterministic checks update `ideas/`/`experiments/` bodies with exact checked scope, explicit Lean premises, and `VERIFICATION.md` links (without forging `claim:` nodes). | `PROOF.md` / `PROOF.tex`, `VERIFICATION.md`, `PROOF_AUDIT.md` | | **5. [`mathrsi-handoff`](base/skills/mathrsi-handoff/SKILL.md)** | Packages the readable proof, standalone reproduction inputs/commands, citation checks, optional HTML/PDF views, final wiki state, and resumption notes. | `render-html`, `citation-audit` / `paper-compile` *(when requested)*, `research-wiki` | **Read**: all active `ideas/`, `claims/`, `experiments/`, and `papers/` pages to verify citation and scope consistency.
**Write**: final stage/outcome sync on `ideas/`, remaining open obligations in `gap_map.md`/`ideas/`, final `rebuild_index`, `rebuild_query_pack`, and `log` aligned with `NEXT_SESSION.md`. | `HANDOFF.md`, `NEXT_SESSION.md`, reproducible bundle | ``` --- #### 2. 中文版（用于替换 [README.zh-CN.md](file:///Users/rfy_naiveai/Desktop/MathRSI/README.zh-CN.md#L37-L48) 图下说明与五阶段表） ```markdown 上图保留为 **v2 历史 workflow 视图**；v3 沿用五阶段。图中的 **Continuous Research Wiki** 横条表示任务工作区的 `/research-wiki/` 贯穿**全部五个阶段**持续读写，而非仅在首尾阶段调用：各阶段协调者先读 `index.md`／`query_pack.md` 定位，再按当前义务精读 `papers/`、`ideas/`、`experiments/`、`claims/` 实体全文；一旦产生可复用条件引理、严格反例、领域探针结论或直接 Lean／确定性核验结果，即由唯一协调者通过 `$ARIS_REPO/tools/research_wiki.py` 与正文增量编辑同步入库（其中 `claim:` 节点严格仅由真实 `proof-checker` 审计创建，直接 Lean 与确定性核验记入对应 `ideas/`／`experiments/` 正文并链接 `VERIFICATION.md`）。完整读写规程见 **[docs/WORKSPACE.md](docs/WORKSPACE.md)**。 | 子流程 | 实际动作与交接 | 内嵌 ARIS 技能 | Wiki 贯穿读写（`/research-wiki/`） | 主要阶段产物 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **1. [`mathrsi-prepare`](base/skills/mathrsi-prepare/SKILL.md)** | 先用 [`specify`](base/skills/mathrsi-specify/SKILL.md) 恢复或澄清初步问题，再由 [`survey`](base/skills/mathrsi-survey/SKILL.md) 广搜、深读关键进口并更新 wiki，最后定稿原题。 | `research-lit`、`research-wiki`、`wiki-enrich` | **读**：既有 `index.md`、`query_pack.md`、`gap_map.md` 及相关 `papers/`、`ideas/` 全文。
**写**：新库 `init`、`ingest_paper`、`wiki-enrich`（补齐原文定理条件与勘误）、`add_edge`，刷新 `index`／`query_pack` 与 `log`。 | `FORMAL_SPEC.md`、`LITERATURE.md`、更新后的 wiki 实体 | | **2. [`mathrsi-route-loop`](base/skills/mathrsi-route-loop/SKILL.md)** | 执行 `auto-review-loop` 数学适配：提案、对抗审阅、推导／探针实作、结果回收与复核，保留各 reviewer 记忆与轮内断点。 | `auto-review-loop` *(数学适配)*、`research-review` *(composed)*、`research-wiki` | **读**：入口读 `query_pack.md` 并精读相关 `ideas/`、`experiments/`、`papers/` 实体全文以避开旧失败。
**写**：新路线 `upsert_idea` 或既有页正文增量更新，已完成探针记 `add_experiment`（`yes`/`partial`/`no`）与 `add_edge`；重大反例／路线否决即时落盘，终轮完成同步与 `log`。 | `ROUTE_REPORT.md`、首批可执行证明义务与审阅 trace | | **3. [`mathrsi-prove`](base/skills/mathrsi-prove/SKILL.md)** | 组合公式推导、证明写作、领域方法与独占 worker，成熟产物立即回收并接回原题 caller。 | `formula-derivation`、`proof-writer`、`proof-orchestrator` *(按需)*、`research-wiki` | **读**：入口先查 `index.md`／`query_pack.md`，再必读当前义务涉及的 `ideas/`、`papers/`、`experiments/`、`claims/` 实体全文（插件 `archive` 仅只读查方法）。
**写**：由协调者串行将已证条件引理、领域证书、严格反例或无益松弛增量写入 `ideas/` 正文及 `experiments/`，并在交接前刷新导航与 `log`。 | `PROOF_DRAFT.md`、计算证书或准确未闭义务 | | **4. [`mathrsi-verify`](base/skills/mathrsi-verify/SKILL.md)** | 自然语言证明按需 [`assemble`](base/skills/mathrsi-assemble/SKILL.md) 并执行确定性独核与 `proof-checker`；仅形式目标直通 `lean-formalize` 核查实际导出、显式参数、构建与公理。 | `proof-writer` *(经 assemble)*、`proof-checker`、`lean-formalize` *(按需)*、`research-wiki` | **读**：读取相关 `ideas/`、`papers/`、`claims/` 全文核对进口假设与历史核验边界。
**写**：`proof-checker` 经 Hook 4 创建／更新规范 `claims/` 节点；直接 Lean 分支与确定性核验将导出声明、显式参数边界及 `VERIFICATION.md` 链接增量写入 `ideas/`／`experiments/`（不伪造 `claim:` 节点）。 | `PROOF.md` / `PROOF.tex`、`VERIFICATION.md`、`PROOF_AUDIT.md` | | **5. [`mathrsi-handoff`](base/skills/mathrsi-handoff/SKILL.md)** | 整理完整可读解答、独立复现材料、引用核查、按需 HTML／PDF 渲染，同步最终 wiki 与恢复入口。 | `render-html`、`citation-audit` / `paper-compile` *(按需)*、`research-wiki` | **读**：通读相关 `ideas/`、`claims/`、`experiments/`、`papers/` 核查引用与结论范围一致。
**写**：同步最终 `ideas/` 状态与剩余开放问题，执行最终 `rebuild_index`、`rebuild_query_pack` 与 `log`，并与 `NEXT_SESSION.md` 入口对齐。 | `HANDOFF.md`、`NEXT_SESSION.md`、可复现交付包 | ```
